name: Recital H
title: REPORT on the protection of the European Union’s financial interests – combating fraud – annual report 2024
part_text: whereas the EU and its Member States share responsibility for the protection of the EU’s financial interests, which covers the deployment of funds under the Recovery and Resilience Facility (RRF)[[14]](#footnote-15)14 and the implementation of the national recovery and resilience plans; whereas the role of national authorities in ensuring an adequate level of protection of the EU’s financial interests has significantly increased under NextGenerationEU (NGEU) and the proposal for the future multiannual financial framework (MFF);
